definitions.explanation: The evening or night of the day before yesterday. A formal, largely written word; in speech people usually say おとといの{晩|ばん} or おとといの{夜|よる}.

examples.japanese: {一昨晩|いっさくばん}、⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}った→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: It rained the night before last.

examples.japanese: {一昨晩|いっさくばん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: I've had a fever since the night before last.

examples.japanese: {一昨晩|いっさくばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}らせた→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This morning I emailed everyone about what was decided at the meeting the night before last.

notes:
REGISTER:
Formal and mostly written — news reports, police statements, and business correspondence. In conversation ⟦おととい→おととい：00877_ototoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧ is the natural choice.

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- ⟦{昨晩|さくばん}→昨晩：10970_sakuban⟧: last night
- ⟦{今晩|こんばん}→今晩：02882_konban⟧: tonight
- {一昨日|おととい}: the day before yesterday
- {一昨年|おととし}: the year before last

The prefix {一昨|いっさく} means "one before last" and appears in a small closed set of time words.
